scope: Preserve actual owner-authorized trusted Sandbox creation, observed security limitations, pass/fail checks, stopped state and accounting without runtime changes.

proactiveReview.architecture: Documentation only. One existing-project source-only session reused existing reviewed inventory; no application integration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, registry, credential, deployment or new persistent service added.
proactiveReview.threats: Do not mistake nonroot UID or microVM availability for qualified generated-code execution.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Observed nonzero capabilities and unlimited process-level limits preserved as unresolved, not hidden.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Fixed positive assertion exit0 and seeded failure exit1 captured in real guest; no hostile code executed.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent precreate QA/Auditor and final actual-result QA/Auditor passed; Auditor independently GET-confirmed stopped provider state.
proactiveReview.recovery: Explicit stop plus independent provider GET confirmed stopped; snapshots empty and no automatic create retry.
proactiveReview.readiness: Trusted session lifecycle proven, untrusted execution unqualified. Existing qualified Preview unchanged.
